overview.startPoint: Talk to Vanescula Drakan, by the rowboat entrance to Meiyerditch near Burgh de Rott.

extra.label: League auto-complete
extra.html: Unlocking Morytania will auto-complete the quest.

required.note: Items from the tool belt are not listed unless they do not work or are not automatically added.

items.html: Blisterwood weaponry or Ivandis flail

blocks.html: Talk to Vanescula Drakan at the docks south-east of Burgh de Rott.
blocks.text: Talk to Vanescula Drakan at the docks south-east of Burgh de Rott.

blocks.caption: The solution to the first ring puzzle.

blocks.html: Board the nearby boat to Icyene graveyard.
blocks.text: Board the nearby boat to Icyene graveyard.

blocks.html: Talk to Safalaan.
blocks.text: Talk to Safalaan.

blocks.html: Solve the ring puzzle by rotating the rings until they turn blue and their markings join together.
blocks.text: Solve the ring puzzle by rotating the rings until they turn blue and their markings join together.

blocks.html: Inspect the statue of Queen Efaritay to receive Efaritay's pendant.
blocks.text: Inspect the statue of Queen Efaritay to receive Efaritay's pendant.

blocks.html: Talk to Safalaan.
blocks.text: Talk to Safalaan.

blocks.html: Travel to the Myreque Hideout with Drakan's medallion, use the Meiyerditch teleport option, and walk into the central room.
blocks.text: Travel to the Myreque Hideout with Drakan's medallion, use the Meiyerditch teleport option, and walk into the central room.

blocks.html: After the cutscene, talk to Safalaan in the northern room.
blocks.text: After the cutscene, talk to Safalaan in the northern room.

blocks.html: Equip your Darkmeyer disguise.
blocks.text: Equip your Darkmeyer disguise.

blocks.html: Use your Drakan's medallion to teleport to Darkmeyer
blocks.text: Use your Drakan's medallion to teleport to Darkmeyer

blocks.html: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz inside the Arboretum. He will not appear until you walk into the central chamber.
blocks.text: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz inside the Arboretum. He will not appear until you walk into the central chamber.

substeps.html: At this point you are able to craft more types of blisterwood weapons.
substeps.text: At this point you are able to craft more types of blisterwood weapons.

blocks.html: Head south-west inside Vanstrom's former mansion.
blocks.text: Head south-west inside Vanstrom's former mansion.

blocks.html: Open then search the vyrewatch crate to obtain vyrewatch uniforms.
blocks.text: Open then search the vyrewatch crate to obtain vyrewatch uniforms.

blocks.html: Return to Veliaf. He will give you a set of the House Drakan outfit.
blocks.text: Return to Veliaf. He will give you a set of the House Drakan outfit.

blocks.html: No items other than the Darkmeyer outfit, House Drakan outfit, Drakan medallion, runes, Ivandis flail, and blisterwood weapons and ammo can be taken to Castle Drakan.
blocks.text: No items other than the Darkmeyer outfit, House Drakan outfit, Drakan medallion, runes, Ivandis flail, and blisterwood weapons and ammo can be taken to Castle Drakan.

blocks.html: Leave the building and head west to the entrance to Castle Drakan.
blocks.text: Leave the building and head west to the entrance to Castle Drakan.

blocks.html: Equip the House Drakan outfit, unequip any weapons, and talk to Vanescula near Overwatch Mornid.
blocks.text: Equip the House Drakan outfit, unequip any weapons, and talk to Vanescula near Overwatch Mornid.

blocks.html: Complete the following to gain status:
blocks.text: Complete the following to gain status:

substeps.html: North-west, talk to Lady Nadezhda Shadum.
substeps.text: North-west, talk to Lady Nadezhda Shadum.

substeps.html: West, talk to Lord Alexei Jovkai.
substeps.text: West, talk to Lord Alexei Jovkai.

options.text: Try the old man - he looks defiant.

substeps.html: East, talk to Lord Mischa Myrmel.
substeps.text: East, talk to Lord Mischa Myrmel.

options.text: Show mercy; make her feel better.

blocks.html: Talk to Vanescula.
blocks.text: Talk to Vanescula.

blocks.caption: The solution to the second ring puzzle.

blocks.html: Exit your cell and unlock the five other cells. You will take damage equal to 10% of your life points. You will have a chance to eat in the next section. Make sure you talk to the Myreque while doing this or the portcullis will not open.
blocks.text: Exit your cell and unlock the five other cells. You will take damage equal to 10% of your life points. You will have a chance to eat in the next section. Make sure you talk to the Myreque while doing this or the portcullis will not open.

blocks.html: Go to the next chamber and solve the ring puzzle. This is similar to the earlier puzzle with the addition that rotating a ring causes the smaller, adjacent ring to rotate as well. Rotating the centre ring causes the outer ring to rotate.
blocks.text: Go to the next chamber and solve the ring puzzle. This is similar to the earlier puzzle with the addition that rotating a ring causes the smaller, adjacent ring to rotate as well. Rotating the centre ring causes the outer ring to rotate.

substeps.html: Start from the outside and work your way in.
substeps.text: Start from the outside and work your way in.

blocks.html: Go to the next chamber and talk to Safalaan.
blocks.text: Go to the next chamber and talk to Safalaan.

blocks.html: Go up the stairs and leave the dungeon.
blocks.text: Go up the stairs and leave the dungeon.

blocks.html: Go to the eastern room and take all the mysterious jerky you are able to from the butchery table.
blocks.text: Go to the eastern room and take all the mysterious jerky you are able to from the butchery table.

substeps.html: Eat to full health, you can take more after eating.
substeps.text: Eat to full health, you can take more after eating.

blocks.html: Talk to Vanescula and Mornid in the western room.
blocks.text: Talk to Vanescula and Mornid in the western room.

blocks.html: Go to the southern room, and read the A Taste of Hope book obtained earlier. Investigate each blood lock. The correct matches are:
blocks.text: Go to the southern room, and read the A Taste of Hope book obtained earlier. Investigate each blood lock. The correct matches are:

blocks.html: Unlock the tithing door south and escape through the cellar exit.
blocks.text: Unlock the tithing door south and escape through the cellar exit.

blocks.html: Enter the tunnel and Lowerniel Drakan will appear.
blocks.text: Enter the tunnel and Lowerniel Drakan will appear.

blocks.html: If you die at any point you will continue from where you died at or just before. You may not bring any potions in, but you can drink them for the potion's effect and then enter. If you log out, you will be returned to Darkmeyer, and to return to the quest go west and enter the gatehouse doors. You will be returned to the last room you were in.

blocks.text: Ground floor

blocks.html: Vandalise the statue of Lord Drakan to obtain a statue spear (if the option to vandalise doesn't appear then enter the east door for a cutscene).
blocks.text: Vandalise the statue of Lord Drakan to obtain a statue spear (if the option to vandalise doesn't appear then enter the east door for a cutscene).

blocks.html: Brace the entrance door.
blocks.text: Brace the entrance door.

blocks.html: Defeat the venator and climb the stairs.
blocks.text: Defeat the venator and climb the stairs.
First floor

blocks.html: When you climb the stairs a timer will start. You will need to smash furniture and collect debris to barricade the windows. If you don't succeed before the timer runs out, a venator will attack.

blocks.text: First room

blocks.html: Smash 2 tables and 3 chairs and collect 9 furniture debris.
blocks.text: Smash 2 tables and 3 chairs and collect 9 furniture debris.

blocks.html: Barricade the three windows. Do not click away before you get the message confirming the window is barricaded.
blocks.text: Barricade the three windows. Do not click away before you get the message confirming the window is barricaded.

blocks.html: Defeat the venator if time runs out and one appears.
blocks.text: Defeat the venator if time runs out and one appears.

blocks.html: You can collect 3 extra debris from smashing the remaining chairs in this room to make subsequent rooms easier.
blocks.text: You can collect 3 extra debris from smashing the remaining chairs in this room to make subsequent rooms easier.

blocks.html: Unlock the blood lock and enter the second room. Another timer will start.
blocks.text: Unlock the blood lock and enter the second room. Another timer will start.
Second room

blocks.html: Smash the table. You should have 6 furniture debris.
blocks.text: Smash the table. You should have 6 furniture debris.

blocks.html: Barricade the two windows. Do not click away before the "the window is barricaded" message appears.
blocks.text: Barricade the two windows. Do not click away before the "the window is barricaded" message appears.

blocks.html: Defeat the venator if time runs out and one appears.
blocks.text: Defeat the venator if time runs out and one appears.

blocks.html: Unlock the blood lock and enter the third room.
blocks.text: Unlock the blood lock and enter the third room.
Third room

blocks.html: Lift the table.
blocks.text: Lift the table.

blocks.html: Defeat the venator.
blocks.text: Defeat the venator.

blocks.html: Lift the table.
blocks.text: Lift the table.

blocks.html: Unlock the blood lock and enter the fourth room.
blocks.text: Unlock the blood lock and enter the fourth room.

blocks.caption: The solution to the third puzzle.

blocks.text: Fourth room

blocks.html: Smash the chairs and table to the right of the door and the weapon racks which are against the north and south sides of the staircase.
blocks.text: Smash the chairs and table to the right of the door and the weapon racks which are against the north and south sides of the staircase.

blocks.html: Barricade the two windows. Defeat the venator if time runs out and one appears.
blocks.text: Barricade the two windows. Defeat the venator if time runs out and one appears.

blocks.html: Solve the puzzle by making the following moves (if you mess up, you can reset the puzzle by talking to Polmafi):
blocks.text: Solve the puzzle by making the following moves (if you mess up, you can reset the puzzle by talking to Polmafi):

blocks.html: Climb upstairs.
blocks.text: Climb upstairs.
Second and third floors

blocks.html: Talk to Veliaf.
blocks.text: Talk to Veliaf.

blocks.html: Climb the stairs on both sides and open the blood valves in each room.
blocks.text: Climb the stairs on both sides and open the blood valves in each room.

substeps.html: After defeating the venator in the western room, check on Ivan.
substeps.text: After defeating the venator in the western room, check on Ivan.

blocks.html: Back on the 2<sup>nd</sup> floor (UK) / 3<sup>rd</sup> floor (US), enter the northern door and open the blood valve.
blocks.text: Back on the 2nd floor (UK) / 3rd floor (US), enter the northern door and open the blood valve.

blocks.caption: The solution to the fourth puzzle.

blocks.html: Climb down the stairs and solve the final ring puzzle by making these moves:
blocks.text: Climb down the stairs and solve the final ring puzzle by making these moves:

substeps.html: Rotate ring B clockwise three times.
substeps.text: Rotate ring B clockwise three times.

substeps.html: Rotate ring D anticlockwise three times.
substeps.text: Rotate ring D anticlockwise three times.

substeps.html: Rotate ring E anticlockwise three times.
substeps.text: Rotate ring E anticlockwise three times.

blocks.html: Before entering the fight you can use stat-boosting potions and prayer restoration potions to make the fight easier, but these items cannot be brought to the fight.
blocks.text: Before entering the fight you can use stat-boosting potions and prayer restoration potions to make the fight easier, but these items cannot be brought to the fight.

blocks.html: Climb the stairs in the ring puzzle room and prepare to fight Lowerniel Drakan.
blocks.text: Climb the stairs in the ring puzzle room and prepare to fight Lowerniel Drakan.

blocks.html: Kill the three venators. (You can stand behind Vertida, Veliaf and Safalaan when attacking each of the venators and they won't attack you, saving you from needing to eat.)
blocks.text: Kill the three venators. (You can stand behind Vertida, Veliaf and Safalaan when attacking each of the venators and they won't attack you, saving you from needing to eat.)

blocks.html: Fight Lowerniel Drakan.
blocks.text: Fight Lowerniel Drakan.

substeps.html: Run away from bombs which appear after he says "Ha ha ha!".
substeps.text: Run away from bombs which appear after he says "Ha ha ha!".

substeps.html: When he says things like "Still trying to run?" or "You think you can escape?" use Anticipation to avoid being stunned and dealt high damage.
substeps.text: When he says things like "Still trying to run?" or "You think you can escape?" use Anticipation to avoid being stunned and dealt high damage.

blocks.html: Fight Lowerniel Drakan again.
blocks.text: Fight Lowerniel Drakan again.

substeps.html: When he says "Fear me!" and transforms into a cloud of dust, run away from the cloud.
substeps.text: When he says "Fear me!" and transforms into a cloud of dust, run away from the cloud.

substeps.html: When he says "Embrace darkness", stand within the sphere of lightning surrounding Safalaan.
substeps.text: When he says "Embrace darkness", stand within the sphere of lightning surrounding Safalaan.

substeps.html: When he says "Graaah!", use Anticipation or Freedom if you get stunned.
substeps.text: When he says "Graaah!", use Anticipation or Freedom if you get stunned.

blocks.html: Jump into the portal and fight Lowerniel Drakan again - he will use the same attacks as in the previous fights.
blocks.text: Jump into the portal and fight Lowerniel Drakan again - he will use the same attacks as in the previous fights.

blocks.html: Talk to Lowerniel Drakan and then fight him for the final time.
blocks.text: Talk to Lowerniel Drakan and then fight him for the final time.

substeps.html: Move away from him when he is doing a special attack (rapid melee attacks) to avoid taking damage.
substeps.text: Move away from him when he is doing a special attack (rapid melee attacks) to avoid taking damage.

blocks.html: Select the "finish" option on Lowerniel Drakan.
blocks.text: Select the "finish" option on Lowerniel Drakan.

blocks.html: Talk to Ivan. A cutscene will follow.
blocks.text: Talk to Ivan. A cutscene will follow.

blocks.html: Talk to Ivan again.
blocks.text: Talk to Ivan again.

blocks.html: Go to Varrock Palace and talk to King Roald.
blocks.text: Go to Varrock Palace and talk to King Roald.

blocks.html: Quest complete!
blocks.text: Quest complete!

items.text: The Tome of xp 4th ed with 3 charges, each charge giving 75,000 XP in a chosen skill at or above level 75
